classes.description: MfgOrderProcedure — 工单生产程序（版本化实体）。定义制造工单(MfgOrder)的产前/产后电子程序执行模板，包含执行模式、目标完成时间、完成时工单状态和任务列表引用。被 MfgOrder 通过 PreProductionProcedureId 和 PostProductionProcedureId 引用。 【Swagger】Schema: MfgOrderProcedureEntity；来源文件: MfgOrderProcedures.json；API: /api/MfgOrderProcedures。

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号(ECO) 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

properties.name: completedOrderStatus
properties.description: 程序完成后工单的目标状态 → OrderStatus 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: targetTime
properties.description: 预计完成时间 【Swagger】Estimated time to complete procedure

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: mfgOrderProcedureBase
properties.description: 物理字段 MfgOrderProcedureBaseId → MfgOrderProcedureBase

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 修订版本号 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: displayMode
properties.description: 显示模式 【Swagger】Identifies how the Electronic Procedure is to be displayed on the UI. 1 = DrillDown 2 = Outline

properties.name: executionMode
properties.description: 执行模式：1=Sequential(顺序), 2=Non-Sequential(非顺序)（必填） 【Swagger】Identifies whether the TaskLists in the Electronic Procedure are to be processed in sequence. 1 = Sequential 2 = Non-Sequential

properties.name: keepCompletedTasks
properties.description: 物理字段 KeepCompletedTasks 【Swagger】When true will prevent deleting ContainerCompletedTasks data for the container at the current step

properties.name: keepCompletedTasksOnOpen
properties.description: 物理字段 KeepCompletedTasksOnOpen 【Swagger】When true will not delete any completed task history
